members.name: tone
members.doc: Fill of the revealed action. Pair `danger` with a label that names the destructive result.

members.name: onSelect
members.doc: Runs for a full swipe, a tap on the revealed action, or the More actions menu. Remove the item here unless `keepRow` is set.

members.name: keepRow
members.doc: The row springs home after the action instead of sliding away and collapsing, for actions such as Mark as unread.

types.name: SwipeActionsProps
types.doc: A list whose rows reveal actions on a horizontal swipe, the way a mail inbox does. Use it for short lists where people triage items quickly. Only one row stays open at a time; touching anywhere else or pressing Escape puts it away. Every row also has a More actions menu with the same actions, so keyboard and screen reader users never need the gesture.

types.name: SwipeActionsRowProps
types.doc: One row. `leading` actions sit under the left edge and `trailing` actions under the right; the outermost action on each side commits on a full swipe.

members.name: label
members.doc: Names the row in its menu button, for example the message subject.

members.name: fullSwipe
members.doc: Lets a long swipe commit the outermost action without a tap. On by default.

members.name: container
members.doc: Render the menu inside this element and limit collisions to it (used by the demo stages).

types.name: LayerProps
types.text: { action: SwipeAction; side: Side; rank: number; count: number; coverRank: number | null; x: MotionValue<number>; cover: MotionValue<number>; onPress: () => void }
